services.title: Income Computation & Disclosure Standards (ICDS)
services.intro: Income Computation and Disclosure Standards (ICDS) are a set of tax accounting standards notified by the Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) under the Income Tax Act, 1961. These standards prescribe the manner in which certain categories of income and expenses should be recognised for the purpose of computing taxable income. ICDS generally applies to taxpayers following the mercantile system of accounting and is intended to bring uniformity and consistency in tax reporting.
services.body:
Income Computation and Disclosure Standards (ICDS) are a set of tax accounting standards notified by the Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) under the Income Tax Act, 1961. These standards prescribe the manner in which certain categories of income and expenses should be recognised for the purpose of computing taxable income. ICDS generally applies to taxpayers following the mercantile system of accounting and is intended to bring uniformity and consistency in tax reporting.

Improper application of ICDS may result in tax adjustments, scrutiny assessments, additional tax liabilities, and prolonged litigation. At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we provide comprehensive ICDS advisory services to help businesses understand the applicability of these standards, align their accounting practices with tax requirements, and ensure accurate computation of taxable income.

Our ICDS Advisory Services

Applicability Assessment

The first step towards ICDS compliance is determining whether the standards apply to your business or professional income. Our professionals carefully evaluate your accounting method, business structure, and nature of transactions to assess the applicability of ICDS provisions.

Our assessment includes:

  1. Review of the accounting system followed by the taxpayer.
  2. Evaluation of business and professional income.
  3. Determination of applicable ICDS provisions.
  4. Identification of compliance requirements based on the nature of operations.

Review of Accounting Policies for Tax Alignment

Accounting policies adopted for financial reporting may differ from those prescribed under ICDS for tax computation. We review your existing accounting practices to identify areas where adjustments may be required for tax purposes.

Our services include:

  1. Review of accounting methods and policies.
  2. Comparison between financial reporting standards and ICDS requirements.
  3. Identification of accounting treatments requiring tax adjustments.
  4. Recommendations for improving tax compliance while maintaining accurate financial reporting.

Identification of Timing Differences

ICDS may require recognition of income or expenses at a different time than financial accounting standards. These timing differences can significantly impact taxable income if not properly identified and reported.

We assist in analysing ICDS implications relating to:

  1. Revenue recognition.
  2. Construction and long-term contracts.
  3. Inventory valuation.
  4. Borrowing costs.
  5. Government grants.
  6. Foreign exchange fluctuations.
  7. Provisions and contingent liabilities.
  8. Other ICDS-specific recognition principles.

Our detailed analysis helps businesses identify and manage timing differences effectively.

Impact Analysis on Taxable Income

ICDS adjustments may influence the amount of taxable income reported during a financial year. We perform a comprehensive impact assessment to quantify these adjustments and help businesses understand their tax implications before filing returns.

Our analysis includes:

  1. Computation of ICDS adjustments.
  2. Comparison between accounting profit and taxable income.
  3. Assessment of additional tax liability, if any.
  4. Evaluation of cash flow implications arising from ICDS compliance.
  5. Advisory on tax planning opportunities within the applicable legal framework.

Support During Scrutiny & Tax Assessments

Questions relating to ICDS often arise during income tax assessments and scrutiny proceedings. Our professionals provide complete assistance in explaining accounting treatments, preparing supporting documentation, and responding to queries raised by tax authorities.

Our services include:

  1. Preparation of explanations and supporting documents.
  2. Assistance in responding to assessment notices.
  3. Representation before Income Tax Authorities.
  4. Clarification of ICDS-related adjustments during scrutiny proceedings.
  5. Advisory for resolving disputes arising from income computation issues.

Benefits of ICDS Compliance

Proper implementation of Income Computation and Disclosure Standards offers several long-term benefits for businesses and professionals.

  1. Accurate computation of taxable income.
  2. Consistency in tax reporting across financial years.
  3. Reduced risk of tax adjustments and reassessments.
  4. Improved preparedness during scrutiny assessments.
  5. Lower exposure to interest, penalties, and litigation.
  6. Better alignment between accounting records and tax computations.
  7. Enhanced confidence in tax compliance and reporting.

Our ICDS Compliance Process

Step

Our Approach

Applicability Review

Determine whether ICDS provisions apply based on the nature of business, accounting method, and income sources.

Accounting Policy Review

Evaluate existing accounting policies and identify areas requiring alignment with ICDS.

Impact Assessment

Analyse timing differences and compute their effect on taxable income.

Implementation Support

Assist in incorporating ICDS adjustments into tax computations and return preparation.

Assessment Assistance

Provide ongoing support during scrutiny assessments, departmental queries, and tax proceedings.

Simplifying ICDS Compliance

Income Computation and Disclosure Standards play a significant role in determining taxable income for many businesses and professionals. Proper implementation not only ensures compliance with the Income Tax Act but also reduces the risk of adjustments, assessments, and future litigation. Our ICDS advisory services provide practical guidance, technical expertise, and continuous support to help taxpayers comply with these standards while maintaining accurate and transparent tax reporting.

services.title: Personal Tax Planning
services.intro: Effective tax planning is an essential part of sound financial management. It helps individuals reduce their tax liability through legitimate tax-saving opportunities while ensuring compliance with the Income Tax Act, 1961. Whether you are a salaried employee, self-employed professional, freelancer, investor, or high-net-worth individual (HNI), a well-planned tax strategy can help you optimise your finances, preserve wealth, and achieve your long-term financial goals.
services.body:
Effective tax planning is an essential part of sound financial management. It helps individuals reduce their tax liability through legitimate tax-saving opportunities while ensuring compliance with the Income Tax Act, 1961. Whether you are a salaried employee, self-employed professional, freelancer, investor, or high-net-worth individual (HNI), a well-planned tax strategy can help you optimise your finances, preserve wealth, and achieve your long-term financial goals.

At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we provide comprehensive Personal Tax Planning services tailored to your income structure, investments, financial objectives, and tax profile. Our professionals analyse your financial position and recommend tax-efficient strategies that maximise available deductions, exemptions, and benefits while ensuring complete compliance with the latest tax regulations.

Our proactive approach helps you make informed financial decisions, minimise tax exposure, and avoid unnecessary tax disputes.

Our Personal Tax Planning Services

Salary Structuring & Tax Optimisation

An efficiently structured salary package can significantly reduce your tax liability without affecting your overall compensation. We assist employees and employers in designing tax-efficient salary structures that comply with applicable tax laws while maximising available exemptions and allowances.

Our services include:

  1. Tax-efficient salary restructuring.
  2. Optimisation of House Rent Allowance (HRA).
  3. Leave Travel Allowance (LTA) planning.
  4. Structuring of allowances and reimbursements.
  5. Advisory on taxable perquisites and employee benefits.
  6. Review of salary components under the old and new tax regimes.

Our objective is to help you maximise your take-home income while remaining fully compliant with tax regulations.

Investment Planning under Sections 80C, 80D, 80G & Other Tax Provisions

Investing wisely not only supports your long-term financial goals but also helps reduce your taxable income. We provide strategic guidance on selecting suitable tax-saving investments based on your financial objectives, risk appetite, and eligibility under various provisions of the Income Tax Act.

Our advisory covers:

  1. Tax-saving investments under Section 80C.
  2. National Pension System (NPS) benefits.
  3. Public Provident Fund (PPF).
  4. Equity Linked Savings Schemes (ELSS).
  5. Life insurance policies.
  6. Health insurance deductions under Section 80D.
  7. Donations eligible under Section 80G.
  8. Other applicable deductions and exemptions.

We ensure your investment decisions align with both your financial goals and tax planning objectives.

Capital Gains Tax Planning

Selling property, shares, mutual funds, or other capital assets can result in significant tax implications. Proper planning before executing a transaction helps minimise tax liability and maximise available exemptions.

Our services include:

  1. Computation of short-term and long-term capital gains.
  2. Advisory on exemptions under Sections 54, 54F, and 54EC.
  3. Guidance on indexation benefits wherever applicable.
  4. Tax planning for property sales and investments.
  5. Advisory on taxation of shares, mutual funds, and securities.
  6. Planning for reinvestment to reduce capital gains tax.

Our professionals help structure your transactions in a tax-efficient manner while ensuring compliance with applicable laws.

Tax Planning under the Old vs New Tax Regime

The introduction of the new tax regime has made tax planning more complex for many taxpayers. Choosing the right regime depends on your income, deductions, exemptions, and overall financial profile.

We assist you by:

  1. Comparing tax liability under both tax regimes.
  2. Analysing eligible deductions and exemptions.
  3. Evaluating long-term tax savings.
  4. Advising on the most beneficial tax regime.
  5. Reviewing tax implications annually based on changing income patterns.

Our personalised approach ensures you choose the option that delivers the maximum tax benefit.

Handling Income Tax Notices & Assessments

Receiving a notice from the Income Tax Department can be stressful, but timely professional assistance can simplify the process considerably. We provide complete support in understanding the notice, preparing appropriate responses, and representing clients before tax authorities wherever required.

Our services include:

  1. Review and analysis of Income Tax notices.
  2. Preparation of legally compliant responses.
  3. Assistance during scrutiny and reassessment proceedings.
  4. Representation before Income Tax Authorities.
  5. Advisory on corrective actions and future compliance.

Our goal is to resolve tax matters efficiently while protecting your interests.

Benefits of Personal Tax Planning

A structured tax planning strategy provides both immediate and long-term financial advantages.

  1. Minimise tax liability through lawful tax-saving opportunities.
  2. Maximise eligible deductions and exemptions.
  3. Improve long-term wealth creation.
  4. Make informed investment decisions.
  5. Optimise salary and retirement benefits.
  6. Reduce the risk of tax notices and penalties.
  7. Improve financial planning and cash flow management.
  8. Ensure complete compliance with the Income Tax Act.

Our Personal Tax Planning Process

Step

Our Approach

Financial Assessment

Review your income, investments, expenses, and financial objectives.

Tax Analysis

Evaluate current tax liability and identify tax-saving opportunities.

Strategy Development

Recommend personalised tax planning solutions based on applicable laws.

Implementation Support

Assist in restructuring salary, investments, and financial transactions.

Annual Review

Reassess your tax position every financial year to optimise savings and ensure continued compliance.

Plan Your Taxes, Protect Your Wealth

Personal tax planning is not just about reducing taxes,it is about making smarter financial decisions that support your future goals. A proactive tax strategy helps you optimise investments, improve cash flow, preserve wealth, and remain compliant with changing tax regulations. At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we provide practical, personalised tax advisory that enables individuals to achieve greater financial efficiency while ensuring complete peace of mind.

services.title: Assessment Proceedings
services.intro: An Income Tax Assessment is a formal process through which the Income Tax Department verifies the accuracy of the income declared in your tax return. Assessments may be initiated due to scrutiny notices, discrepancies in tax returns, high-value financial transactions, information received through AIS or Form 26AS, or risk-based selection by the department. Timely and well-prepared responses are essential to avoid unnecessary tax additions, penalties, and prolonged litigation.
services.body:
An Income Tax Assessment is a formal process through which the Income Tax Department verifies the accuracy of the income declared in your tax return. Assessments may be initiated due to scrutiny notices, discrepancies in tax returns, high-value financial transactions, information received through AIS or Form 26AS, or risk-based selection by the department. Timely and well-prepared responses are essential to avoid unnecessary tax additions, penalties, and prolonged litigation.

At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we provide comprehensive representation during assessment proceedings, helping taxpayers respond effectively to departmental notices while ensuring compliance with applicable legal provisions. Our professionals carefully analyse each case, prepare detailed submissions, and represent clients before the Assessing Officer to safeguard their interests.

Our Assessment Representation Services

Drafting & Filing Replies to Income Tax Notices

Responding accurately and within the prescribed timelines is crucial during assessment proceedings. We prepare technically sound replies supported by relevant facts, financial records, and legal provisions.

Our assistance includes:

  1. Drafting responses to scrutiny notices.
  2. Replying to reassessment notices.
  3. Responding to information requests and departmental communications.
  4. Preparation of supporting explanations and documentary evidence.

Preparation of Detailed Submissions & Supporting Documentation

Strong documentation forms the foundation of a successful assessment.

We assist in preparing:

  1. Financial statements.
  2. Income reconciliations.
  3. Bank statements and transaction summaries.
  4. Books of accounts.
  5. Agreements, contracts, invoices, and supporting records.
  6. Tax computation statements and working papers.

Representation Before the Assessing Officer (AO)

Our professionals represent clients during assessment proceedings, whether conducted physically or through the faceless assessment system.

Our representation includes:

  1. Technical clarification of tax positions.
  2. Presentation of supporting documents.
  3. Addressing departmental queries.
  4. Coordination throughout the assessment process.

Reconciliation of AIS, Form 26AS & Financial Records

Differences between tax returns and government records often trigger scrutiny.

We assist in:

  1. Reconciliation of Form 26AS.
  2. Review of the Annual Information Statement (AIS).
  3. Verification of Taxpayer Information Summary (TIS).
  4. Resolution of TDS mismatches.
  5. Reconciliation of high-value financial transactions.

Penalty & Interest Defence

Where penalty proceedings or interest demands arise, we evaluate the legal position and prepare appropriate responses to minimise financial exposure.

Our support includes:

  1. Defence against penalty notices.
  2. Review of interest calculations.
  3. Preparation of legal submissions.
  4. Representation before tax authorities.

Benefits of Professional Assessment Representation

  1. Timely and accurate responses to notices.
  2. Reduced risk of tax additions and penalties.
  3. Strong documentation supporting your case.
  4. Effective communication with tax authorities.
  5. Better preparedness during scrutiny proceedings.
  6. Improved chances of favourable assessment outcomes.

Our Assessment Process

Step

Our Approach

Notice Review

Analyse the notice and identify key issues requiring attention.

Documentation

Collect, verify, and organise supporting financial records.

Response Preparation

Draft detailed submissions supported by applicable legal provisions.

Representation

Represent you before the Assessing Officer during proceedings.

Closure & Compliance

Assist in implementing the assessment outcome and future compliance measures.

Professional Support Throughout the Assessment Process

Income tax assessments require careful preparation, accurate documentation, and a well-planned response strategy. Our Assessment Representation services help taxpayers navigate scrutiny proceedings confidently while protecting their rights and ensuring compliance with the Income Tax Act. Through timely intervention and practical guidance, we help minimise litigation risks and work towards favourable assessment outcomes.

services.title: Appeals before CIT(A)
services.intro: If you disagree with an assessment order passed by the Income Tax Department, you have the right to file an appeal before the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) [CIT(A)]. A well-prepared appeal supported by strong legal arguments, factual documentation, and judicial precedents can significantly improve the chances of obtaining relief. Timely filing and proper representation are essential to safeguard your rights and prevent unnecessary tax liabilities.
services.body:
If you disagree with an assessment order passed by the Income Tax Department, you have the right to file an appeal before the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) [CIT(A)]. A well-prepared appeal supported by strong legal arguments, factual documentation, and judicial precedents can significantly improve the chances of obtaining relief. Timely filing and proper representation are essential to safeguard your rights and prevent unnecessary tax liabilities.

At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we assist taxpayers in preparing and managing appeals before the CIT(A). Our professionals carefully review the assessment order, identify legal and factual issues, and develop a structured strategy to present your case effectively.

Our CIT(A) Appeal Services

Drafting of Appeal Memorandum & Grounds of Appeal

A strong appeal begins with clearly drafted grounds supported by relevant provisions of the Income Tax Act and applicable judicial decisions.

Our services include:

  1. Drafting appeal memorandums.
  2. Preparing detailed grounds of appeal.
  3. Reviewing assessment orders.
  4. Identifying legal and factual errors.

Preparation of Statement of Facts

A comprehensive Statement of Facts provides the appellate authority with a clear understanding of the background and circumstances of the case.

We assist in:

  1. Preparing factual summaries.
  2. Presenting supporting documentation.
  3. Explaining assessment discrepancies.
  4. Organising records for appellate proceedings.

Submission of Written Arguments & Case Laws

Well-supported written submissions strengthen the appeal and demonstrate the legal validity of your position.

Our professionals assist with:

  1. Drafting detailed written submissions.
  2. Researching relevant judicial precedents.
  3. Citing applicable circulars and notifications.
  4. Preparing legal arguments based on case facts.

Representation During Appellate Hearings

We represent clients throughout the appellate process, whether hearings are conducted physically or through the faceless appeal system.

Our representation includes:

  1. Attending appellate hearings.
  2. Presenting factual and legal submissions.
  3. Responding to queries raised by appellate authorities.
  4. Coordinating throughout the appeal proceedings.

Stay Petitions & Demand Relief Applications

Where immediate tax recovery may cause financial hardship, we assist clients in seeking appropriate interim relief.

Our services include:

  1. Drafting stay petitions.
  2. Filing applications for demand relief.
  3. Representation before the concerned authorities.
  4. Follow-up on pending applications.

Benefits of Professional Appeal Representation

  1. Well-structured and legally supported appeals.
  2. Strong documentation and factual presentation.
  3. Effective representation before appellate authorities.
  4. Improved chances of obtaining tax relief.
  5. Assistance throughout the appellate process.
  6. Timely compliance with statutory timelines.

Our Appeal Process

Step

Our Approach

Case Review

Examine the assessment order and identify appealable issues.

Documentation

Collect supporting records and prepare necessary documents.

Appeal Drafting

Draft grounds of appeal, statement of facts, and written submissions.

Representation

Represent you during appellate proceedings and hearings.

Order & Further Advisory

Review the appellate order and advise on the next course of action, if required.

Professional Assistance for Income Tax Appeals

An appeal before the CIT(A) provides taxpayers with an opportunity to challenge incorrect or unjustified assessment orders. Our experienced professionals ensure that every appeal is prepared with accuracy, supported by strong legal arguments, and presented effectively before the appellate authority to achieve the most favourable outcome possible.

services.title: Representation before ITAT, HC, SC
services.intro: Certain tax disputes involve complex legal issues that require adjudication by higher judicial forums such as the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT), High Courts, and the Supreme Court of India. These proceedings demand in-depth technical knowledge, careful legal analysis, and comprehensive documentation to effectively present the taxpayer's case.
services.body:
Certain tax disputes involve complex legal issues that require adjudication by higher judicial forums such as the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT), High Courts, and the Supreme Court of India. These proceedings demand in-depth technical knowledge, careful legal analysis, and comprehensive documentation to effectively present the taxpayer's case.

At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we provide end-to-end litigation support for matters before higher judicial authorities. Our professionals work closely with clients and, where required, coordinate with senior advocates to ensure every matter is handled with diligence, procedural compliance, and strategic planning.

Our Higher-Level Litigation Services

Drafting Appeals before ITAT

A properly drafted appeal forms the foundation of successful litigation before the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal.

Our services include:

  1. Preparation and filing of Form 36.
  2. Drafting appeal memorandums.
  3. Preparation of paper books.
  4. Review of assessment and appellate orders.

Representation before ITAT Benches

We provide professional representation during proceedings before various ITAT benches across India.

Our representation includes:

  1. Presenting legal and factual arguments.
  2. Responding to departmental submissions.
  3. Filing additional evidence where permissible.
  4. Assistance throughout tribunal proceedings.

Coordination for High Court & Supreme Court Matters

Where matters involve substantial questions of law or further appeals, we provide comprehensive litigation support.

Our services include:

  1. Coordination for tax appeals before High Courts.
  2. Assistance with writ petitions.
  3. Support for Special Leave Petitions (SLPs) before the Supreme Court.
  4. Coordination with senior counsel whenever required.

Preparation of Case Summaries & Legal Documentation

Comprehensive documentation plays a vital role in higher judicial proceedings.

We assist with:

  1. Preparation of case summaries.
  2. Compilation of supporting records.
  3. Research on judicial precedents.
  4. Preparation of legal documentation and written submissions.

Strategic Litigation Planning

Before initiating higher-level litigation, it is important to assess the legal merits and commercial implications of the case.

Our advisory includes:

  1. Litigation strategy development.
  2. Evaluation of legal risks.
  3. Cost-benefit analysis.
  4. Recommendations on the appropriate legal course of action.

Benefits of Professional Litigation Support

  1. Strong legal documentation.
  2. Strategic case planning.
  3. Experienced representation before judicial forums.
  4. Procedural compliance at every stage.
  5. Coordination with legal experts when necessary.
  6. Focus on achieving sustainable legal outcomes.

Our Litigation Process

Step

Our Approach

Case Evaluation

Review previous orders and assess the merits of the case.

Documentation

Prepare appeals, paper books, and supporting documents.

Legal Representation

Represent clients before the appropriate judicial forum.

Litigation Management

Coordinate hearings, filings, and procedural requirements.

Final Outcome & Advisory

Assist with implementation of orders and advise on future legal options.

Experienced Representation Before Higher Judicial Forums

Tax litigation before ITAT, High Courts, and the Supreme Court requires technical expertise, careful preparation, and a strategic approach. Our professionals provide comprehensive representation to help taxpayers effectively present their case while protecting their rights throughout the litigation process.

services.title: Rectification, Revision & Refunds
services.intro: Errors in assessment orders, tax computations, TDS credits, or return processing can lead to incorrect tax demands or delays in receiving eligible refunds. The Income Tax Act provides taxpayers with various remedies, including rectification and revision, to correct such errors and ensure that taxes are assessed fairly. Timely action is essential to prevent unnecessary financial burden and safeguard your legal rights.
services.body:
Errors in assessment orders, tax computations, TDS credits, or return processing can lead to incorrect tax demands or delays in receiving eligible refunds. The Income Tax Act provides taxpayers with various remedies, including rectification and revision, to correct such errors and ensure that taxes are assessed fairly. Timely action is essential to prevent unnecessary financial burden and safeguard your legal rights.

At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we assist individuals, businesses, and organisations in filing rectification and revision applications, resolving refund-related issues, and addressing discrepancies affecting tax credits. Our professionals carefully review each case and provide practical solutions to help clients recover eligible refunds and correct procedural errors efficiently.

Our Rectification, Revision & Refund Services

Filing Rectification Applications

Rectification applications are filed to correct apparent mistakes in assessment orders, intimation notices, or tax computations that may have resulted in incorrect tax demands or denial of eligible benefits.

Our services include:

  1. Filing rectification applications before the appropriate authority.
  2. Correction of errors in assessment orders and intimations.
  3. Review of tax computations and demand calculations.
  4. Preparation of supporting documents and submissions.

Revision Applications Before Appropriate Authorities

Where an assessment order is prejudicial or requires reconsideration, revision applications may provide an appropriate remedy under the Income Tax Act.

We assist in:

  1. Evaluating eligibility for revision.
  2. Drafting revision petitions.
  3. Preparation of supporting legal submissions.
  4. Representation before the relevant authorities.

Refund Tracking & Follow-Up

Delays in refund processing can occur due to verification issues, mismatches, or procedural deficiencies. We actively monitor refund status and coordinate with the Income Tax Department to facilitate timely resolution.

Our services include:

  1. Refund status monitoring.
  2. Follow-up with tax authorities.
  3. Resolution of refund processing issues.
  4. Assistance with refund-related notices and communications.

Interest on Refund Claims

Taxpayers may be entitled to interest on delayed refunds under applicable provisions of the Income Tax Act. We review refund calculations to ensure that all eligible interest has been correctly computed.

Our assistance includes:

  1. Verification of refund interest calculations.
  2. Review of refund orders.
  3. Representation for incorrect or omitted interest.
  4. Follow-up for pending refund payments.

Correction of TDS Mismatches & Credit Issues

services.title: Faceless Assessment & Appeal Assistance
services.intro: The Income Tax Department has introduced the Faceless Assessment and Faceless Appeal system to promote transparency, efficiency, and accountability in tax administration. Under this digital framework, taxpayers are required to respond to notices, upload supporting documents, and participate in proceedings through the online e-filing portal. Since all communications are conducted electronically, timely submissions and accurate documentation are essential for a successful outcome.
services.body:
The Income Tax Department has introduced the Faceless Assessment and Faceless Appeal system to promote transparency, efficiency, and accountability in tax administration. Under this digital framework, taxpayers are required to respond to notices, upload supporting documents, and participate in proceedings through the online e-filing portal. Since all communications are conducted electronically, timely submissions and accurate documentation are essential for a successful outcome.

At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we provide comprehensive assistance for faceless assessment and appeal proceedings by preparing technically sound submissions, managing online compliance, and representing clients throughout the digital litigation process. Our professionals ensure that every response is prepared with precision and submitted within the prescribed timelines.

Our Faceless Proceedings Support Includes

Drafting Comprehensive Online Submissions

Well-prepared written submissions play a crucial role in presenting the taxpayer's position during faceless proceedings.

Our services include:

  1. Drafting detailed responses to notices.
  2. Preparation of factual and legal submissions.
  3. Compilation of supporting explanations.
  4. Review of departmental queries before submission.

Uploading Supporting Documentation on the E-Portal

Proper organisation and submission of documents help avoid delays and reduce the risk of adverse observations during assessment or appeal.

We assist with:

  1. Uploading supporting documents through the Income Tax e-filing portal.
  2. Verification of documents before submission.
  3. Organising financial records and evidence.
  4. Ensuring complete and accurate online filings.

Timely Compliance with E-Proceeding Deadlines

Missing statutory deadlines can result in adverse orders or loss of legal remedies. Our professionals closely monitor notices and ensure timely compliance throughout the proceedings.

Our assistance includes:

  1. Monitoring notice timelines.
  2. Preparing responses within prescribed deadlines.
  3. Managing multiple communications received through the portal.
  4. Compliance tracking throughout the proceedings.

Video Conference Hearing Representation

Where the Income Tax Department schedules virtual hearings, we assist clients by preparing submissions and representing them during the proceedings.

Our services include:

  1. Preparation for virtual hearings.
  2. Representation during video conference proceedings.
  3. Clarification of technical and factual issues.
  4. Submission of additional documents, where required.

Strategic Handling of Risk-Based Scrutiny Cases

Many faceless assessments are initiated through data analytics and risk-based selection. We carefully analyse the issues raised and develop an appropriate response strategy to address departmental concerns.

Our support includes:

  1. Review of risk parameters.
  2. Reconciliation of financial information.
  3. Preparation of supporting evidence.
  4. Strategic representation during assessment and appeal.

Benefits of Professional Faceless Assessment Support

  1. Accurate and timely online submissions.
  2. Complete documentation and record management.
  3. Reduced compliance risks.
  4. Professional representation throughout digital proceedings.
  5. Better coordination during assessments and appeals.
  6. Assistance with complex scrutiny matters.

Review the outcome and provide guidance on subsequent compliance or appellate remedies.

Professional Assistance for Faceless Tax Proceedings

Faceless assessments and appeals require careful planning, prompt responses, and technically accurate submissions. Our professionals provide end-to-end support throughout the digital litigation process, helping taxpayers comply with procedural requirements while effectively presenting their case before the Income Tax Department.

services.title: Tax Due Diligence
services.intro: Tax Due Diligence is an essential part of mergers, acquisitions, investments, business restructuring, and strategic transactions. It helps identify potential tax risks, compliance gaps, pending litigations, and hidden liabilities before a transaction is completed. Conducting a thorough tax review enables buyers, investors, and businesses to make informed decisions while reducing future tax exposure.
services.body:
Tax Due Diligence is an essential part of mergers, acquisitions, investments, business restructuring, and strategic transactions. It helps identify potential tax risks, compliance gaps, pending litigations, and hidden liabilities before a transaction is completed. Conducting a thorough tax review enables buyers, investors, and businesses to make informed decisions while reducing future tax exposure.

At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we perform comprehensive tax due diligence by reviewing historical tax records, compliance status, and ongoing tax matters to provide clients with a clear understanding of potential risks and opportunities.

Our Tax Due Diligence Services

Comprehensive Review of Income Tax Returns & Assessments

We examine historical tax records to evaluate the overall tax position of the business.

Our review includes:

  1. Income Tax Returns filed over previous years.
  2. Assessment orders and scrutiny proceedings.
  3. Outstanding tax demands.
  4. Pending tax disputes and appeals.

Identification of Tax Contingent Liabilities

Potential tax liabilities may significantly impact the value of a transaction if not identified in advance.

We assist in:

  1. Identifying contingent tax liabilities.
  2. Reviewing pending penalty proceedings.
  3. Evaluating ongoing tax litigation.
  4. Assessing potential future tax exposures.

Review of TDS, Advance Tax & Compliance Records

Compliance history provides valuable insight into the tax health of an organisation.

Our review includes:

  1. TDS compliance.
  2. Advance tax payments.
  3. Statutory filing history.
  4. Tax payment reconciliations.

Analysis of Tax Positions & Aggressive Claims

Certain deductions, exemptions, or tax positions may increase the likelihood of future scrutiny.

We evaluate:

  1. Tax deductions claimed.
  2. Exemptions and incentives availed.
  3. Significant tax positions adopted.
  4. Potential compliance risks.

Transaction Risk Assessment Report

After completing the review, we prepare a detailed due diligence report highlighting identified risks and recommended corrective measures.

The report includes:

  1. Risk categorisation.
  2. Compliance observations.
  3. Potential financial exposure.
  4. Recommendations for risk mitigation.

Benefits of Tax Due Diligence

  1. Identification of hidden tax liabilities.
  2. Better decision-making during transactions.
  3. Reduced post-acquisition tax risks.
  4. Improved tax compliance.
  5. Enhanced investor confidence.
  6. Structured risk assessment.

Reliable Tax Due Diligence for Strategic Transactions

Our Tax Due Diligence services help businesses, investors, and acquirers identify potential tax risks before completing important transactions. By providing a comprehensive assessment of tax compliance and exposure, we enable clients to make informed decisions with greater confidence.

Businesses engaged in international transactions must consider domestic tax laws, Double Taxation Avoidance Agreements (DTAAs), transfer pricing regulations, and foreign tax reporting requirements to avoid unnecessary tax liabilities and regulatory challenges.

Businesses engaged in international transactions must consider domestic tax laws, Double Taxation Avoidance Agreements (DTAAs), transfer pricing regulations, and foreign tax reporting requirements to avoid unnecessary tax liabilities and regulatory challenges.

At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we provide comprehensive International Taxation services to help businesses and individuals manage cross-border tax obligations efficiently while remaining compliant with applicable laws.

Our International Taxation Services

Cross-Border Tax Structuring Advisory

Proper tax structuring helps businesses optimise international transactions while maintaining regulatory compliance.

Our advisory includes:

  1. Structuring overseas investments.
  2. Cross-border transaction planning.
  3. Tax-efficient business models.
  4. International business expansion advisory.

We assist with:

  1. DTAA interpretation.

  4. Cross-border tax planning.

Our services include:

Transfer Pricing Compliance & Documentation

We assist with:

services.title: TDS on Non-resident Payments
services.intro: Payments made to non-residents are subject to specialised withholding tax provisions under the Income Tax Act, 1961, and applicable Double Taxation Avoidance Agreements (DTAAs). Determining the correct tax deduction requires careful analysis of the nature of the payment, residential status of the recipient, treaty benefits, and regulatory requirements. Incorrect withholding may result in interest, penalties, and disallowance of expenses.

services.title: Gift Tax & Clubbing Provisions
services.intro: Transferring money, property, or investments among family members can have significant tax implications under the Income Tax Act. While certain gifts are exempt from tax, others may attract taxation or trigger the clubbing provisions, resulting in income being taxed in the hands of the transferor. Careful planning is essential to ensure that family asset transfers remain tax-efficient and fully compliant with applicable laws.
services.body:
Transferring money, property, or investments among family members can have significant tax implications under the Income Tax Act. Careful planning is essential to ensure that family asset transfers remain tax-efficient and fully compliant with applicable laws.

services.body:
Section 44AB of the Income Tax Act mandates tax audits for specified businesses and professionals whose turnover or gross receipts exceed the prescribed limits. The objective of the audit is to verify the accuracy of books of accounts, ensure proper computation of taxable income, and confirm compliance with various provisions of the Income Tax Act. Timely completion of the audit helps businesses avoid penalties, strengthens financial transparency, and reduces the likelihood of future tax disputes.

At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we provide end-to-end Tax Audit services under Section 44AB for businesses across various industries. Our professionals conduct detailed examinations of financial records, evaluate statutory compliance, and prepare audit reports in accordance with applicable tax laws.

Our Tax Audit Services for Businesses

Applicability Assessment & Turnover Threshold Evaluation

The first step in every tax audit is determining whether the audit provisions apply to the business based on turnover, gross receipts, cash transactions, and other prescribed conditions.

Our assessment includes:

  1. Evaluation of turnover and gross receipts.
  2. Review of prescribed audit thresholds.
  3. Analysis of cash receipt and payment ratios.
  4. Applicability under presumptive taxation provisions, where relevant.

Comprehensive Examination of Books of Accounts

A detailed review of financial records helps ensure that the books of accounts accurately reflect the business's financial position.

We examine:

  1. Sales and purchase registers.
  2. Ledger accounts and journal entries.
  3. Trial balance and financial statements.
  4. Revenue recognition practices.
  5. Classification of capital and revenue expenditure.
  6. Inventory and stock valuation records.

Verification of Statutory Compliance

We review statutory compliances to ensure consistency across various tax and regulatory filings.

Our review includes:

  1. TDS deductions and return filings.
  2. Reconciliation of Form 26AS and AIS.
  3. GST return reconciliation with financial statements.
  4. Advance tax and self-assessment tax payments.
  5. Verification of statutory dues such as PF, ESI, and other applicable compliances.

Identification of Disallowances & Reporting Adjustments

Our audit identifies transactions that may require reporting or adjustment under the Income Tax Act.

We review:

  1. Expenses liable for disallowance.
  2. Cash payments exceeding prescribed limits.
  3. Interest and related party transactions.
  4. Specified payments requiring disclosure.
  5. Other reporting adjustments under applicable tax provisions.

Review of Related Party Transactions & Specified Payments

Certain transactions require additional disclosures under the tax audit report.

We assist in reviewing:

  1. Related party transactions.
  2. Specified domestic transactions.
  3. Loans and advances.
  4. Transactions requiring reporting under Form 3CD.

Clause-by-Clause Reporting under Form 3CD

Form 3CD requires detailed reporting of various financial and tax-related particulars.

Our services include:

  1. Preparation of Form 3CD.
  2. Verification of statutory disclosures.
  3. Review of depreciation and deductions.
  4. Reporting of accounting policies and ICDS compliance.
  5. Review of other prescribed reporting clauses.

Electronic Filing of Tax Audit Report

After completion of the audit, we prepare and electronically file the applicable tax audit reports within the prescribed due dates.

Our assistance includes:

  1. Preparation of Form 3CA or Form 3CB, as applicable.
  2. Electronic filing of audit reports.
  3. Coordination with management for approvals.
  4. Timely submission to avoid penalties.

Benefits of Professional Tax Audit Services

  1. Compliance with Section 44AB requirements.
  2. Accurate reporting of financial and tax information.
  3. Early identification of tax risks and compliance gaps.
  4. Reduced exposure to penalties and scrutiny.
  5. Improved financial transparency.
  6. Timely filing of statutory audit reports.

Our Tax Audit Process

Step

Our Approach

Applicability Review

Determine whether the business is liable for tax audit under Section 44AB.

Financial Review

Examine books of accounts, financial statements, and supporting records.

Compliance Verification

Review tax filings, statutory payments, and regulatory compliance.

Audit Reporting

Prepare Form 3CA/3CB and Form 3CD with all required disclosures.

E-Filing & Advisory

Electronically file the audit report and provide recommendations for improved compliance.

Ensuring Accurate and Compliant Tax Audits

A properly conducted tax audit helps businesses strengthen compliance, improve financial reporting, and reduce potential tax risks. Our Section 44AB Tax Audit services provide a structured and comprehensive approach to audit and reporting, enabling businesses to meet their statutory obligations with confidence while maintaining transparency and regulatory compliance.

Tax Audit Services for Professionals

Professionals such as doctors, lawyers, architects, engineers, consultants, chartered accountants, freelancers, and other independent practitioners are required to comply with the tax audit provisions under Section 44AB when their gross professional receipts exceed the prescribed limits or when they become liable for audit under the presumptive taxation provisions. A professionally conducted tax audit helps ensure accurate reporting of income, proper claim of allowable expenses, and compliance with the Income Tax Act.

At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we provide comprehensive tax audit services for professionals, helping them maintain accurate financial records, comply with statutory requirements, and minimize the risk of scrutiny and penalties.

Our Professional Tax Audit Services

Gross Receipts & Applicability Assessment

We evaluate whether a tax audit is applicable based on the nature of the profession, gross receipts, and the relevant provisions of the Income Tax Act.

Our assessment includes:

  1. Evaluation of gross professional receipts.
  2. Applicability under Section 44AB.
  3. Review of presumptive taxation provisions.
  4. Assessment of audit requirements based on declared income.

Verification of Professional Receipts & Billing Records

Proper reporting of professional income is essential for accurate tax computation and audit compliance.

We review:

  1. Billing records and invoices.
  2. Client agreements and engagement documents.
  3. Bank statement reconciliations.
  4. Professional fee receipts.
  5. Identification of income mismatches, if any.

Examination of Allowable Professional Expenses

We verify expenses claimed to ensure they are allowable under the Income Tax Act and appropriately supported.

Our review includes:

  1. Office rent and administrative expenses.
  2. Employee salaries and consultancy payments.
  3. Travel and business-related expenses.
  4. Equipment purchases and depreciation.
  5. Classification of capital and revenue expenditure.

TDS & Advance Tax Compliance Review

Proper reconciliation of tax credits and advance tax payments helps prevent unnecessary tax demands.

We assist with:

  1. Verification of TDS credits.
  2. Reconciliation with Form 26AS and AIS.
  3. Review of advance tax payments.
  4. Assessment of interest implications, where applicable.

Reporting under Form 3CD

Where applicable, we prepare the prescribed disclosures required under Form 3CD.

Our services include:

  1. Review of statutory disclosures.
  2. Reporting of depreciation and deductions.
  3. Disclosure of specified transactions.
  4. Compliance with prescribed reporting requirements.

Timely Filing & Compliance Management

We ensure timely completion and electronic filing of the audit report while providing guidance on future compliance.

Our assistance includes:

  1. Preparation of audit reports.
  2. Electronic submission within due dates.
  3. Compliance monitoring.
  4. Advisory to reduce future compliance risks.

Benefits of Professional Tax Audit Services

  1. Accurate reporting of professional income.
  2. Proper claim of eligible deductions and expenses.
  3. Compliance with Section 44AB requirements.
  4. Reduced risk of penalties and scrutiny.
  5. Timely filing of audit reports.
  6. Improved financial transparency.

Reliable Tax Audit Support for Professionals

Our professional tax audit services help independent practitioners meet their statutory obligations with confidence. By ensuring accurate reporting, proper documentation, and timely compliance, we enable professionals to focus on their practice while minimizing tax risks.

services.title: Audit under Presumptive Taxation
services.intro: The presumptive taxation schemes under Sections 44AD, 44ADA, and 44AE simplify tax compliance for eligible taxpayers by allowing income to be declared on a presumptive basis. Understanding these provisions is essential to avoid penalties and ensure timely compliance.

services.title: Statutory Audit under Companies Act, 2013
services.intro: Every company registered under the Companies Act, 2013 is required to maintain proper books of accounts and undergo a statutory audit by an independent Chartered Accountant. The primary objective of a statutory audit is to ensure that the financial statements present a true and fair view of the company's financial position while complying with the applicable provisions of the Companies Act, Accounting Standards, and Standards on Auditing (SAs).
services.body:
Every company registered under the Companies Act, 2013 is required to maintain proper books of accounts and undergo a statutory audit by an independent Chartered Accountant. The primary objective of a statutory audit is to ensure that the financial statements present a true and fair view of the company's financial position while complying with the applicable provisions of the Companies Act, Accounting Standards, and Standards on Auditing (SAs).

At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we provide comprehensive statutory audit services for Private Limited Companies, Public Limited Companies, and other corporate entities. Our audit approach focuses on accuracy, regulatory compliance, financial transparency, and strengthening internal financial controls.

Our Statutory Audit Services Include

Audit of Financial Statements

We conduct an independent examination of financial statements to ensure they are prepared in accordance with the applicable accounting framework.

Our audit includes:

  1. Audit of Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss Account, and Cash Flow Statement.
  2. Verification of accounting records and supporting documents.
  3. Review of accounting policies and estimates.
  4. Compliance with applicable Accounting Standards.

Compliance with Companies Act & Standards on Auditing

We ensure that the audit is conducted in accordance with the Companies Act, 2013 and the Standards on Auditing (SAs) issued by the ICAI.

Our review includes:

  1. Compliance with statutory provisions.
  2. Verification of statutory disclosures.
  3. Evaluation of financial reporting practices.
  4. Review of regulatory compliances.

Verification of Internal Controls

Strong internal controls improve financial reliability and reduce operational risks.

We assess:

  1. Internal financial controls.
  2. Accounting processes.
  3. Financial reporting systems.
  4. Risk management procedures.

Reporting & Audit Opinion

Upon completion of the audit, we issue an independent audit report highlighting our observations and expressing an opinion on the financial statements.

Benefits of Statutory Audit

  1. Compliance with the Companies Act, 2013.
  2. Improved financial transparency.
  3. Increased stakeholder confidence.
  4. Identification of financial and compliance risks.
  5. Strengthened internal controls.
  6. Reliable financial reporting.

Our statutory audit services help companies meet their legal obligations while improving financial governance, transparency, and stakeholder confidence through a structured and independent audit process.

It also helps reduce the risk of scrutiny, penalties, and future tax disputes.

services.body:
Accurate reconciliation between GST returns, financial statements, and accounting records is essential for maintaining GST compliance and minimizing the risk of notices or disputes. A comprehensive GST reconciliation helps identify mismatches, reporting errors, and compliance gaps before statutory filings are completed.

At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we provide GST Audit and GSTR-9C reconciliation services to ensure consistency between financial records and GST returns while supporting accurate statutory reporting.

Our GST Audit & Reconciliation Services Include

GST Data Reconciliation

We reconcile GST returns with books of accounts and financial statements.

Our services include:

  1. GSTR reconciliation.
  2. Turnover reconciliation.
  3. Tax liability verification.
  4. Input Tax Credit reconciliation.

Review of GST Records

We examine GST records to ensure completeness and accuracy.

Our review includes:

  1. Purchase and sales registers.
  2. Tax invoices.
  3. Electronic credit ledger.
  4. GST returns.

Identification of Mismatches

We identify discrepancies between GST records and financial data that may require corrective action.

Preparation of GSTR-9C

We assist in preparing and reviewing GSTR-9C and related reconciliations, wherever applicable under the prevailing GST provisions.

Benefits of GST Audit & Reconciliation

  1. Accurate GST reporting.
  2. Reduced reconciliation errors.
  3. Better Input Tax Credit management.
  4. Improved compliance.
  5. Lower risk of notices.
  6. Reliable GST documentation.

Strengthening GST Compliance Through Accurate Reconciliation

Our GST Audit and Reconciliation services help businesses maintain consistency across GST records and financial statements, improving compliance while reducing the likelihood of future disputes.

services.title: Financial Due Diligence
services.intro: Financial Due Diligence is a critical step before any investment, merger, acquisition, business restructuring, or strategic partnership. It provides stakeholders with an independent assessment of a company's financial health, identifies potential risks, and validates the accuracy of financial information before important business decisions are made.
services.body:
Financial Due Diligence is a critical step before any investment, merger, acquisition, business restructuring, or strategic partnership. It provides stakeholders with an independent assessment of a company's financial health, identifies potential risks, and validates the accuracy of financial information before important business decisions are made.

At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we conduct comprehensive Financial Due Diligence engagements that help investors, buyers, lenders, and business owners evaluate financial performance, identify potential liabilities, and make informed decisions with confidence.

Our Financial Due Diligence Services Include

Financial Statement Review

We conduct a detailed examination of financial statements to assess the financial position and performance of the business.

Our review includes:

  1. Analysis of audited financial statements.
  2. Review of revenue and profitability.
  3. Examination of assets and liabilities.
  4. Cash flow analysis.

Review Before Investment, Acquisition or Merger

We evaluate financial information before strategic transactions to identify potential risks and opportunities.

Our assessment includes:

  1. Investment readiness review.
  2. Merger and acquisition support.
  3. Financial risk evaluation.
  4. Identification of contingent liabilities.

Working Capital & Cash Flow Analysis

We assess the adequacy of working capital and evaluate liquidity to understand the financial stability of the business.

Financial Risk Assessment

We identify financial risks that may impact the proposed transaction and provide practical recommendations.

Benefits of Financial Due Diligence

  1. Informed investment decisions.
  2. Early identification of financial risks.
  3. Greater transaction transparency.
  4. Improved negotiation support.
  5. Reduced post-acquisition surprises.
  6. Enhanced stakeholder confidence.

Supporting Confident Business Decisions

Our Financial Due Diligence services provide valuable insights into the financial health of a business, helping investors and organizations make well-informed decisions while minimizing financial and operational risks.

services.title: Fraud Investigation & Forensic Review
services.intro: Financial fraud, misappropriation of funds, and operational irregularities can expose businesses to significant financial losses, legal disputes, and reputational damage. A structured Fraud Investigation & Forensic Review helps identify the root cause of irregularities, trace financial transactions, gather supporting evidence, and recommend corrective actions to strengthen internal controls.
services.body:
Financial fraud, misappropriation of funds, and operational irregularities can expose businesses to significant financial losses, legal disputes, and reputational damage. A structured Fraud Investigation & Forensic Review helps identify the root cause of irregularities, trace financial transactions, gather supporting evidence, and recommend corrective actions to strengthen internal controls.

At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we provide independent Fraud Investigation and Forensic Review services to help organizations detect fraudulent activities, investigate financial irregularities, and improve governance through objective financial analysis.

Our Fraud Investigation & Forensic Review Services Include

Investigation of Financial Irregularities

We conduct detailed examinations of suspicious financial transactions and business activities.

Our services include:

  1. Identification of irregular transactions.
  2. Review of accounting records.
  3. Examination of financial discrepancies.
  4. Investigation of unusual financial activities.

Fund Flow & Misuse Analysis

We analyze the movement of funds to identify possible diversion, misuse, or unauthorized transactions.

Our review includes:

  1. Fund flow analysis.
  2. Verification of financial transactions.
  3. Identification of fund misuse.
  4. Financial trail examination.

Evidence Collection & Documentation

We gather and document financial evidence to support investigations and management decision-making.

Our services include:

  1. Supporting document verification.
  2. Transaction analysis.
  3. Evidence compilation.
  4. Investigation reporting.

Internal Control Assessment

Following the investigation, we evaluate existing controls and recommend improvements to reduce the likelihood of similar incidents.

Benefits of Fraud Investigation & Forensic Review

  1. Early detection of financial irregularities.
  2. Identification of fund diversion and misuse.
  3. Improved internal controls.
  4. Stronger financial governance.
  5. Support for dispute resolution.
  6. Reduced risk of future fraud.

Protecting Businesses Through Independent Investigations

Our Fraud Investigation & Forensic Review services help organizations uncover financial irregularities, assess potential risks, and strengthen governance through independent investigation, detailed financial analysis, and practical recommendations for fraud prevention and risk mitigation.

services.title: Limited Review Report
services.intro: A Limited Review is an independent review engagement conducted to provide moderate assurance on the financial statements of an entity. It is commonly required for quarterly and half-yearly financial reporting and helps stakeholders gain confidence in the accuracy and reliability of financial information without the scope of a full statutory audit.
services.body:
A Limited Review is an independent review engagement conducted to provide moderate assurance on the financial statements of an entity. It is commonly required for quarterly and half-yearly financial reporting and helps stakeholders gain confidence in the accuracy and reliability of financial information without the scope of a full statutory audit.

At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we provide Limited Review services in accordance with the applicable Standards on Review Engagements (SREs) and regulatory requirements. Our review focuses on identifying material inconsistencies, verifying financial information, and supporting transparent financial reporting.

Our Limited Review Services Include

Quarterly & Half-Yearly Financial Review

We review interim financial statements to assess whether they have been prepared in accordance with the applicable financial reporting framework.

Our review includes:

  1. Quarterly financial review.
  2. Half-yearly financial review.
  3. Analytical review procedures.
  4. Financial statement consistency review.

Financial Information Verification

We examine key financial records and supporting information to identify material misstatements or inconsistencies.

Compliance Review

We assess compliance with applicable accounting standards and regulatory reporting requirements.

Limited Review Report

Upon completion of the engagement, we issue an independent Limited Review Report based on our review procedures.

Benefits of Limited Review

  1. Greater confidence in interim financial reporting.
  2. Improved financial transparency.
  3. Early identification of reporting issues.
  4. Better regulatory compliance.
  5. Enhanced stakeholder confidence.
  6. Timely financial reporting.

Reliable Interim Financial Reporting

Our Limited Review services provide management, investors, lenders, and other stakeholders with greater confidence in interim financial statements through independent review and professional reporting.

services.title: Agreed Upon Procedures (AUP)
services.intro: Agreed Upon Procedures (AUP) engagements involve performing specific procedures agreed between the client and other intended users to verify particular financial or operational information. Unlike an audit, an AUP engagement reports factual findings without expressing an audit opinion or assurance conclusion.

services.title: Certification for Government Grants
services.intro: Government departments, funding agencies, and public sector organizations often require certifications confirming that grants, subsidies, or financial assistance have been utilized for their intended purposes and in accordance with the prescribed conditions. Independent certification promotes transparency, accountability, and continued eligibility for future funding.
services.body:
Government departments, funding agencies, and public sector organizations often require certifications confirming that grants, subsidies, or financial assistance have been utilized for their intended purposes and in accordance with the prescribed conditions. Independent certification promotes transparency, accountability, and continued eligibility for future funding.

At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we provide Government Grant Certification services by verifying fund utilization, supporting documentation, and compliance with the terms and conditions of the grant.

Our Government Grant Certification Services Include

Verification of Grant Utilization

We examine project expenditure and supporting records to confirm that grant funds have been utilized appropriately.

Our review includes:

  1. Verification of expenditure.
  2. Fund utilization analysis.
  3. Supporting document verification.
  4. Budget comparison.

Compliance with Grant Conditions

We evaluate compliance with the terms, conditions, and reporting requirements prescribed by the funding authority.

Certification & Reporting

Based on our verification procedures, we prepare and issue utilization certificates and other certification reports required by government departments and funding agencies.

Benefits of Government Grant Certification

  1. Demonstrates proper utilization of grant funds.
  2. Supports compliance with funding conditions.
  3. Enhances transparency and accountability.
  4. Strengthens credibility with funding agencies.
  5. Facilitates timely submission of required certifications.
  6. Reduces the risk of compliance issues.

Trusted Certification for Government-Funded Projects

Our Government Grant Certification services help organizations demonstrate responsible utilization of public funds through accurate verification, regulatory compliance, and professionally issued certifications, enabling them to meet funding obligations with confidence.

services.title: Maintenance of Books of Accounts
services.intro: Maintaining accurate books of accounts is fundamental to every business, irrespective of its size or industry. Proper bookkeeping not only supports informed decision-making but also ensures compliance with statutory requirements, facilitates tax reporting, and provides a clear picture of the organization's financial health.
services.body:
Maintaining accurate books of accounts is fundamental to every business, irrespective of its size or industry. Proper bookkeeping not only supports informed decision-making but also ensures compliance with statutory requirements, facilitates tax reporting, and provides a clear picture of the organization's financial health.

At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we provide professional bookkeeping and accounting services tailored to the needs of businesses, startups, LLPs, companies, professionals, and non-profit organizations. Our team maintains accurate financial records using leading accounting platforms while ensuring timely recording and reconciliation of transactions.

Our Bookkeeping Services Include

Recording of Financial Transactions

We maintain complete and accurate books of accounts by recording day-to-day financial transactions.

Our services include:

  1. Sales and purchase accounting.
  2. Receipt and payment entries.
  3. Journal entries.
  4. General ledger maintenance.
  5. Expense recording.

Accounting in Leading Software

We maintain books using widely accepted accounting platforms based on your business requirements.

Our expertise includes:

  1. Tally.
  2. QuickBooks.
  3. Zoho Books.
  4. ERP-based accounting systems.
  5. Customized accounting software.

Bank & Ledger Reconciliation

We perform periodic reconciliations to ensure accuracy and completeness of financial records.

Our review includes:

  1. Bank reconciliation.
  2. Ledger reconciliation.
  3. Customer and vendor reconciliation.
  4. Balance confirmation.

Compliance-Oriented Bookkeeping

We maintain accounting records that support GST, Income Tax, TDS, statutory audits, and financial reporting requirements.

Benefits of Professional Bookkeeping

  1. Accurate financial records.
  2. Timely accounting updates.
  3. Improved financial visibility.
  4. Better statutory compliance.
  5. Reduced accounting errors.
  6. Reliable information for business decisions.

Our bookkeeping services help businesses maintain organized financial records, improve compliance, and create a strong foundation for financial reporting and long-term growth.

services.title: RERA Registration for Builders / Developers
services.intro: Under the Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016 (RERA), builders and developers are required to register eligible real estate projects with the respective State RERA Authority before advertising, marketing, booking, or selling units. Proper registration ensures regulatory compliance, enhances transparency, and builds buyer confidence.
services.body:
Under the Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016 (RERA), builders and developers are required to register eligible real estate projects with the respective State RERA Authority before advertising, marketing, booking, or selling units. Proper registration ensures regulatory compliance, enhances transparency, and builds buyer confidence.

At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we provide end-to-end assistance for RERA registration, helping builders and developers complete the registration process through accurate documentation, online filing, and regulatory coordination.

Our RERA Registration Services Include

Eligibility Assessment

We assess whether the project requires registration under the applicable State RERA regulations.

Project Registration

Our services include:

  1. Online registration of real estate projects on the RERA portal.
  2. Preparation and review of application documents.
  3. Compilation of statutory disclosures.
  4. Submission of registration applications.

Documentation Support

We assist in preparing approvals, title documents, financial information, project plans, and other records required for registration.

Regulatory Coordination

We track the application process, respond to regulatory queries, and assist until registration approval is obtained.

Benefits

  1. Timely RERA registration.
  2. Complete regulatory compliance.
  3. Professional documentation support.
  4. Improved project credibility.
  5. Faster approval process.
  6. Enhanced buyer confidence.

Construction delays, regulatory approvals, force majeure events, or other genuine circumstances may require developers to seek an extension or renewal of their registered project under the applicable State RERA Authority. Timely submission of extension applications with complete documentation helps ensure continued compliance and uninterrupted project execution.

At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we provide end-to-end assistance for RERA Project Extension and Renewal Applications, managing documentation, regulatory filings, and coordination with the relevant authorities.

Our Project Extension & Renewal Services Include

Eligibility Assessment

We review the reasons for extension and assess eligibility under the applicable State RERA regulations.

Documentation Preparation

We prepare extension applications, supporting affidavits, declarations, and project-related documents required for approval.

Regulatory Filing

Our services include:

Preparation of RERA extension forms.

Filing of project extension or renewal applications.

Submission of supporting documentation.

Regulatory coordination with the RERA Authority.

Approval Support

We monitor the application process, respond to regulatory queries, and assist until the extension or renewal is approved.

Benefits

Timely extension of project registration.

Compliance with RERA regulations.

Professional documentation support.

Reduced regulatory risks.

Smooth approval process.

Continued project compliance.
